scope: Sierra Magina hiking catalog closure status

official_park_inventory.source_name: Junta de Andalucia - Ventana del Visitante
official_park_inventory.note: The 17-route signposted inventory and 17/17 live official technical-sheet baseline are closed. This does not mean every route track is geometry-validated or currently open to users.

exception_notes: Larva is audited, but no named official pedestrian route with a dedicated technical sheet/track was located. No route is invented to force 16/16 route presence.

provincial_hiking_network.source_name: Diputacion de Jaen - Jaen Paraiso Interior
provincial_hiking_network.validation_note: R1, R2, R3, R6, R7 and R9 official KMZ files were downloaded and geometry-reviewed. R2 and R6 use explicit repeated-segment semantics for out-and-back routes rather than duplicating shared geometry. R4, R5 and R8 retain official rutometer distances but no explicit public authoritative GPX/KML/KMZ artifact was located; guessed URLs are forbidden.

homologated_network.source_name: Federacion Andaluza de Deportes de Montana, Escalada y Senderismo
homologated_network.safety_note: GR-7 remains homologated and its Sierra Magina stages 8-12 are geometry-validated, but the Jaen route page warns that no maintenance has been notified since 1998 and describes scarce/deteriorated signage. Geometry validation is not a safety clearance.

geometry_sources.rediam_access_blocker: Both direct GML and browser-like KML requests returned HTTP 403 for all 17 routes from GitHub Actions.
geometry_sources.validation_note: All 17 official-core routes have a confirmed REDIAM CODIGOEQUI. REDIAM is blocked from GitHub runners. Eight Diputacion/FAM KMZ targets and five Sierra Magina GR-7 stage archives were downloaded, hashed, parsed and geometry-reviewed successfully.

municipal_comarca_tracks.source_name: Ayuntamiento de Mancha Real - Turismo Mancha Real
municipal_comarca_tracks.access_blocker: The three official KML links resolve to archivos.campusfortalezas.com, whose HTTPS certificate fails strict hostname verification for that hostname. TLS verification is not disabled to force geometry validation.

operational_safety.note: Operational closure does not delete a catalog record and is independent from editorial publication/track validation.

requirements: Every publishable route must have a real track.
Every publishable route track must be geometry-validated.
Technical distance/elevation/duration values must be sourced or derived from validated geometry with documented methodology.
Current closures/incidents must remain independent from catalog publication state.
Duplicate or overlapping Junta/Diputacion/GR-PR-SL records must preserve provenance and canonical relationships instead of being silently merged.
publication_gate.reason_not_closed: The official Junta inventory and live technical-sheet baseline are closed 17/17, REDIAM source identification is closed 17/17, the current GR/PR/SL baseline is geometry-validated, six provincial routes have validated official KMZ tracks, R4/R5/R8 have an explicit audited no-public-track state, and three Mancha Real municipal KML artifacts are authoritatively linked but blocked by a TLS hostname mismatch. Remaining blockers are REDIAM geometry access from an allowed environment and incomplete municipal authoritative geometry validation/discovery.
